stem:
A student uses three sediments to make a cementation model. She layers the sediments in a container as shown.

Incomplete Cementation Model

What should the student do NEXT to complete the model of cementation?

options.label: A
options.text: Mix food coloring with each sediment

options.label: B
options.text: Add a heat source above the container

options.label: C
options.text: Shake the container until materials mix

options.label: D
options.text: Add enough glue to fill gaps in materials

visual_elements: Image of a cylindrical container showing three labeled layers: Gravel, Silt, Sand
